operations.description: Delete a qshow.

operations.description: Delete a quote. The user needs to be the owner of the quote to be able to delete it.

operations.description:
Gets `Quote of the Day`.
Optional `category` param determines
the category of returned quote of the day
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] qod [PARAMS] category said secret so they x [SCHEMA] quote response

operations.description: Gets a list of `Quote of the Day` Categories.

operations.description: Gets a details about a qshow.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] qshow [PARAMS] id said secret so they x [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Get the list of Qshows in They Said So platform.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] qshow list [PARAMS] public said secret so start they x [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Get the quotes in a given Qshow.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] qshow quotes [PARAMS] id said secret so they x [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Gets a `Quote` with a given `id`.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] quote [PARAMS] id said secret so they x [SCHEMA] quote response

operations.description: Gets a list of author names in the system.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] quote authors [PARAMS] said secret so start they x [SCHEMA]

operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] quote categories [PARAMS] said secret so start they x [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Gets a Random Quote image. Optional `category` param determinesthe category of quote used in the image. Optional `author` param gets the quote image of a given author.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] quote image search [PARAMS] author category private said secret so they x [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Get the list of quotes in your private collection.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] quote list [PARAMS] said secret so start they x [SCHEMA]

operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] quote random [PARAMS] said secret so they x [SCHEMA] quote response

operations.description: Search for a `Quote` in They Said So platform. Optional `category` , `author`, `minlength`, `maxlength` params determines the filters applied while searching for the quote.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] quote search [PARAMS] author category maxlength minlength private query said secret so they x [SCHEMA] quote response
